login.headline: Pick up where you left off
login.description: Log in to manage your rentals, message providers and get back on the trail sooner.

bookings.title: Your bookings in one place
bookings.body: See upcoming pickups, past rentals and receipts without digging through email.

checkout.title: Faster checkout
checkout.body: Saved details mean you can lock in gear for your dates in a couple of taps.

verified.title: Verified providers
verified.body: Every listing comes from a provider we've checked, with secure payments throughout.

login.title: Log in
login.subtitle: New to GearUp? <link>Create an account</link>
login.footnote: By logging in you agree to our <link>Terms and Privacy Policy</link>.

alerts.suspended: Your account has been suspended, so you've been signed out. Please contact support if you think this is a mistake.
alerts.google: We couldn't complete your Google sign-in. Please try again, or log in with your email and password.
alerts.google_denied: You cancelled the Google sign-in, so nothing was changed. Try again whenever you're ready.

notices.reset: Your password has been changed. Log in with your new password.
notices.verified: Your email is verified. Log in to keep going.

meta.title: Sign up · GearUp
meta.description: Create a GearUp account to rent gear by the day, or list your own kit and earn from it.

register.headline: Gear up for the next trip
register.description: One account to book kit from local providers — or to start renting out your own.

rent.title: Rent instead of buy
rent.body: Tents, kayaks and bikes by the day — no storage, no upkeep, no commitment.

earn.title: Earn from idle kit
earn.body: List gear you're not using and set your own price per day as a provider.

secure.title: Booked and paid securely
secure.body: Availability is checked against your dates and payments are handled online.

register.title: Create your account
register.subtitle: Already have one? <link>Log in</link>
register.footnote: By creating an account you agree to our <link>Terms and Privacy Policy</link>.

CUSTOMER.title: I want to rent
CUSTOMER.body: Browse and book gear for your trips.

PROVIDER.title: I want to list
PROVIDER.body: Rent out gear you already own.

forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.description: Enter the email you signed up with and we'll send you a link to choose a new one.
forgot.sent: If an account exists for {email}, a reset link is on its way. It works for 30 minutes.
forgot.nothingArrived: Nothing arrived? Check your spam folder, or <retry>try another email</retry>.

reset.incompleteDescription: Open the link from your email again, or request a new one.
reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.description: Pick something you don't use anywhere else.
reset.failed: Couldn't reset your password. Try again.
reset.signedOutNote: You'll be signed out on your other devices.

verify.successDescription: Thanks! You can now pay for rentals and publish listings.
verify.incomplete: The link is incomplete. Open it from your email again.
verify.alreadyClicked: Already clicked it once? Then you're probably verified already — links only work one time.
verify.logInToResend: <link>Log in</link> to send yourself a new link.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.emailTaken: An account with this email already exists.
